name: iflow-mcp-iamgublin-ida-codex-mcp

tools.name: ida_list_functions
tools.description: List all functions from current IDA database

tools.name: ida_call_graph
tools.description: Get call graph from a function (depth-limited)

tools.name: ida_analyze_function
tools.description: Analyze a function to guess its role based on called functions. Returns analysis results WITHOUT renaming by default. Use ida_list_functions to get valid function names. IMPORTANT: Only set rename=true when explicitly asked to rename the function.

max_depth.description: Maximum depth for call graph analysis (1-3 recommended)

rename.description: CAUTION: Set to true ONLY when user explicitly requests renaming. Default false means analysis only, no modifications to IDA database.

rename_locals.description: CAUTION: Set to true ONLY when user explicitly requests renaming local variables. Requires rename=true.

tools.name: ida_get_pseudocode
tools.description: Return Hex-Rays/F5 pseudocode for a function. IMPORTANT: Use function 'name' parameter (recommended), not 'ea'. Get function names from ida_list_functions first. Supports pagination for large content.

name.description: Function name (RECOMMENDED - e.g., 'DriverEntry', 'sub_118C0'). Use ida_list_functions to get valid names.

ea.description: Function start address in decimal (AVOID if possible - must be > 0). Use 'name' instead.

offset.description: Starting line number (0-based) for pagination. Default is 0 (from beginning).

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. If not specified, returns all lines. Use for pagination of large functions.

tools.name: ida_get_disassembly
tools.description: Return full disassembly for a function. IMPORTANT: Use function 'name' parameter (recommended), not 'ea'. Get function names from ida_list_functions first. Supports pagination for large content.

name.description: Function name (RECOMMENDED - e.g., 'DriverEntry', 'sub_118C0'). Use ida_list_functions to get valid names.

ea.description: Function start address in decimal (AVOID if possible - must be > 0). Use 'name' instead.

offset.description: Starting line number (0-based) for pagination. Default is 0 (from beginning).

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to return. If not specified, returns all lines. Use for pagination of large functions.

tools.name: ida_add_pseudocode_comment
tools.description: Add a comment inside Hex-Rays pseudocode at the given line number (line+comment plus name or ea required)

tools.name: ida_rename_function
tools.description: Rename a function in IDA by old name

tools.name: ida_get_imports
tools.description: Get all imports (imported functions from DLLs) from the IDA database

tools.name: ida_get_exports
tools.description: Get all exports (exported functions) from the IDA database

tools.name: ida_get_xrefs
tools.description: Get all cross-references (xrefs) to a variable, function, or address. Shows where the target is used/called in the code.

target.description: Target name (e.g., 'dword_5CE14', 'sub_12FA8') or address in decimal. Use ida_list_functions or ida_get_imports to find valid names.

tools.name: ida_list_globals
tools.description: List all global variables/data in the IDA database (paginated). Returns named data symbols from data segments.

count.description: Maximum number of globals to return (1-1000)

tools.name: ida_read_memory
tools.description: Read raw bytes from a specific memory address in the IDA database. Returns hex dump and ASCII representation.

address.description: Memory address to read from (in decimal)

tools.name: ida_get_strings
tools.description: List all strings found in the IDA database (paginated). Returns string content, location, type, and cross-references.

count.description: Maximum number of strings to return (1-1000)

tools.name: ida_jump_to_address
tools.description: Jump to a specific address in IDA (similar to pressing 'g' and entering address). Useful for navigating to function pointers or data locations.

address.description: Target address to jump to (in decimal)

tools.name: ida_set_data_type
tools.description: Set the data type at a specific address (byte, word, dword, qword, etc.). Similar to pressing 'D' then type key in IDA.

address.description: Address to set data type for (in decimal)

data_type.description: Data type to set (byte=1, word=2, dword=4, qword=8 bytes)

tools.name: ida_set_function_pointer_type
tools.description: Set a function pointer type at a specific address (similar to pressing 'Y' in IDA). This helps Hex-Rays recognize function pointers and display proper function calls instead of MEMORY[address]. FIXED: Now supports simplified signatures.

address.description: Address to set function pointer type for (in decimal)

function_signature.description: Function signature. Supports simplified formats: 'NTSTATUS', 'NTSTATUS __fastcall', etc. Also accepts full signatures like 'NTSTATUS (__fastcall *)(void *a1, void *a2, int a3, int a4, int a5)'

tools.name: ida_set_name
tools.description: Set a name for an address (similar to pressing 'N' in IDA). INTELLIGENT: Automatically detects function pointers and sets proper QWORD data type + function pointer type, making Hex-Rays display function calls correctly instead of MEMORY[address]. Useful for naming function pointers, variables, or functions.

tools.name: ida_create_function_pointer
tools.description: Complete workflow: convert MEMORY[address] calls to named function calls. This combines jump, set qword data type, set function pointer type, and naming in one operation. FIXED: Now supports simplified signatures like 'NTSTATUS __fastcall'.

address.description: Address of the function pointer (in decimal)

function_signature.description: Function signature. Supports simplified formats: 'NTSTATUS', 'NTSTATUS __fastcall', 'HANDLE', etc. Also accepts full signatures like 'NTSTATUS (__fastcall *)(void *, void *, int, int, int)'
